website_summary.name: Community Q&A Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and organized interface with a beige background and saddle brown accents, designed for easy interaction and readability.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a simple yet effective design. It includes a header with the site logo ("Ask & Answer") and a tagline ("Get answers to your questions"). The main navigation area contains a search bar for finding existing questions and a button to submit new ones. On the left sidebar, there's a section titled "Ask a Question," which includes a form for users to submit their queries. Below this, another section explains "How it Works," outlining the three steps: asking a question, getting answers, and rating them. The central part of the page displays a message indicating no questions were found, suggesting users adjust their search or ask a new question. The footer provides links to additional resources such as About, Help, Privacy, and Terms. The overall color scheme uses beige for the background and saddle brown for the primary components, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several key functionalities. Users can submit questions via a dedicated form, which requires them to type their query into a text box and click a "Submit Question" button. There’s also a search bar allowing users to look for existing questions and answers. Additionally, the site enables users to get answers from the community and rate those answers to help others find the most useful responses. The footer links provide access to further information about the platform, including its policies and guidelines.

functionality_testing.name: Adjust Search Query Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that adjusting the search query in the Search Bar and resubmitting it triggers the search function and displays relevant results.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The search bar contains a relevant keyword.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The search results should display a list of questions matching the new keyword. 7. Next Steps : Clear the current search query and enter a different keyword to see if any matching questions are found.
procedure: Clear the current search query.
Enter a different keyword into the Search Bar.
Click the search icon or press Enter to submit the search query.
Verify that the search results are displayed.

functionality_testing.name: Ask a Question Card Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Ask a Question Card displays correctly and allows users to enter questions.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The card is visible and accessible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The question should be submitted without errors, and the card should display the entered question.
procedure: Hover over the Ask a Question Card.
Click on the Question Input textbox.
Enter a question and click the Submit Question Button.
Verify that the question is submitted successfully.
